column1: # The nav regression spots (NAV FIRST, 2026-11-05/06): one walk a row, from the feet at (fx, fy, fz) toward (tx, ty, tz).
# controller: what the client's own walk tick does there (walk: it gets the body there; no: it does not), as real bodies do (humans' or
# clients' passes). grid: what the default grid has there today (way: a way within WAY_FACTOR x the straight line + WAY_PLUS_M; none:
# no such way; ?: printed, not asserted). A nav change that opens or closes a spot flips its row in the same PR, on purpose.
